name: Adam Marlow
title: Product Strategy Lead | Built Environment & PropTech Innovation
bio: Adam is a cross-cultural product strategist with deep expertise in the built environment. He holds a PhD in Architecture from Tohoku University (Sendai, Japan), with research focused on climate-responsive design and occupant comfort in hot-humid climates. Adam has founded and led design firms, developed proptech solutions, and works at the intersection of architecture, technology, and sustainability.

highlights: Led product strategy for real estate tech platform
Managed cross-functional teams across Japan and overseas
Shipped features improving user engagement by 40%
Published research on adaptive thermal comfort
Smart home IoT experiments for occupant behavior
Founded architecture & design consultancy in Malaysia
Built team of 10 designers and project managers

fun_facts: Fluent in English, Malay, and conversational Japanese
Created a Kanji learning game app
Loves exploring abandoned buildings and brutalist architecture
